pageDescription: Configure the platform-wide name, system language, and brand assets.
serverOwnedHint: Changes are saved on the server and applied to every browser.
platformNameHint: After saving, the name appears in the top bar, sidebar branding, and browser title.
languageHint: Uses the same system language setting as the “文/A” button in the top-right corner.
colorLogoHint: Used by light menus and light themes
lightLogoHint: Used by dark menus and dark themes
faviconHint: Icon shown in the browser tab
unlimitedImagesHint: Multiple and unlimited uploads; PNG, JPG, or ICO, up to 2 MB each
emptyLibrary: No custom images yet. Upload images from the panel above.
assetSelected: Image selected. Save the configuration to apply it.
fileTooLarge: The image must not exceed 2 MB
deleteAssetConfirm: Delete “{name}”? This action cannot be undone.
deleteFailed: Could not delete the image. Replace and save any active assignment first.
